component.name: Astra Weather
component.summary: Real-time weather applet for COSMIC Desktop with Tempest Weather Station integration

description.p: Astra Weather Applet integrates with WeatherFlow Tempest Weather Stations to provide real-time weather data, lightning detection, and comprehensive forecasts directly in your COSMIC Desktop panel.

ul.li: Real-time WebSocket updates - Live weather data every 2-3 seconds
Lightning, high-wind, and rain alerts with desktop notifications
Multi-day forecasts - 7-day hourly (240 cards) and 10-day daily forecasts
Multiple station support - Manage and switch between Tempest stations
5 languages - English, German, Spanish, Scottish Gaelic, Japanese (100% synchronized)
6 unit systems - Temperature, wind speed, pressure, precipitation, distance, time
Station health monitoring - Real-time connection status with color-coded indicators
Secure API key storage - System keyring with automatic fallback
Color weather icons - 11 bundled icons with day/night variants

description.p: Note: This applet requires a WeatherFlow Tempest Weather Station and API key to function.

screenshot.caption: 7-day hourly forecast with 240 cards, color weather icons, and automatic day/night variants
Real-time weather conditions from your Tempest station with WebSocket updates every 2-3 seconds
Station health monitoring with REST API and WebSocket connection status
Desktop notifications for lightning strikes, rain events, and high winds
Compact panel display with temperature, weather icon, and wind direction
Comprehensive unit preferences - 6 unit types with multiple options

description.p: Initial release of Astra Weather Applet for COSMIC Desktop

ul.li: Real-time WebSocket integration with Tempest Weather Stations
Lightning detection with desktop notifications and visual alerts
7-day hourly and 10-day daily forecasts with color icons
Multiple station support with health monitoring
5 fully synchronized languages (en, de, es, gd, ja)
Secure API key storage via Secret Service D-Bus API
Handler-based architecture with 51 handlers across 9 modules
